title: Recall Quiz: Social Aspects & Group Dynamics

questions.q: Which leadership style involves the coach making all the decisions without asking for input from the athletes?
questions.qPa: ਕਿਸ ਲੀਡਰਸ਼ਿਪ ਸ਼ੈਲੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਕੋਚ ਖਿਡਾਰੀਆਂ ਦੀ ਸਲਾਹ ਲਏ ਬਿਨਾਂ ਸਾਰੇ ਫੈਸਲੇ ਲੈਂਦਾ ਹੈ?
questions.explanation: Autocratic (or dictatorial) leaders retain all decision-making power.

questions.q: The process by which individuals learn the values, beliefs, and norms of a society through sports is known as:
questions.explanation: Socialization is the sociological process of learning to participate in group life.

questions.q: When a team works effectively together on the field to win a match, even if they don't socialize off the field, they are demonstrating high:
questions.qPa: ਜਦੋਂ ਇੱਕ ਟੀਮ ਮੈਚ ਜਿੱਤਣ ਲਈ ਮੈਦਾਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਮਿਲ ਕੇ ਕੰਮ ਕਰਦੀ ਹੈ, ਭਾਵੇਂ ਉਹ ਮੈਦਾਨ ਤੋਂ ਬਾਹਰ ਦੋਸਤ ਨਾ ਹੋਣ, ਉਹ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਦਰਸ਼ਿਤ ਕਰ ਰਹੇ ਹਨ?
questions.explanation: Task cohesion refers to the degree to which members work together to achieve a specific, performance-related goal.

questions.q: A coach who acts as a facilitator and allows the team to make almost all decisions with minimal interference is using which leadership style?
questions.explanation: Laissez-Faire literally means 'let them do', characterized by a hands-off approach.

questions.q: Which leadership style is generally considered best for building trust, intrinsic motivation, and team morale in experienced athletes?
questions.explanation: Democratic leadership involves athletes in decision-making, increasing their investment and morale.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT a typical social benefit derived from participating in team sports?
questions.explanation: Sports generally decrease social isolation by integrating individuals into a group.

questions.q: In the context of sports, respecting the referee's decision even when you disagree is an example of:
questions.explanation: Sportsmanship involves respecting the rules, officials, and opponents.

questions.q: For a newly formed team of very young, inexperienced children, which leadership style might a coach need to rely on initially to establish basic order and safety?
questions.explanation: Inexperienced groups or dangerous situations often require strict, autocratic direction initially for safety and order.
